items.title: U.S. Steel Stocks Riding Tariff Backed Demand Growth
items.summary: The Mesabi Metallics plan for a record scale Iowa steel plant has pushed U.S. steel producers back into the spotlight, raising fresh questions about who might benefit from an increase in domestic capacity and tariff protected supply. Long lead projects like this can quietly reshape entire sectors, which means early positioning can matter. This piece walks through three U.S. steel stocks tied to this news and what their exposure could mean for a diversified portfolio. The stocks below are just...

items.title: Cleveland-Cliffs Sinks 9% as Selloff Outruns Steel Group; Nucor and Steel Dynamics Pull Back
items.summary: Cleveland-Cliffs is falling far harder than Nucor, Steel Dynamics, and the broader steel sector combined, and the reason traces back to a policy question that cuts against the company in two directions at once.

items.title: Cleveland-Cliffs Jumps 5% as Month-Long Rebound Extends; Nucor and Steel Dynamics Tick Up
items.summary: Cleveland-Cliffs is surging well past its steel peers on Tuesday with no confirmed catalyst behind the move, and the gap between its year-to-date performance and Nucor's tells a story about where the next trade could be hiding.
